categories.main_business_segments: PeptiDream operates two main business segments: (1) Drug Discovery and Development, leveraging its proprietary Peptide Discovery Platform System (PDPS) for peptide-based drug discovery, and (2) Radiopharmaceuticals, through its wholly owned subsidiary PDR Pharma, focusing on the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of diagnostic and therapeutic radiopharmaceuticals, primarily for cancer and neurological diseases.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technology is the PDPS (Peptide Discovery Platform System), which enables the rapid identification and optimization of highly diverse, cyclic peptides with high affinity and selectivity for target proteins, including non-natural amino acids. This platform underpins both internal and partnered drug discovery programs, including peptide drugs, peptide-drug conjugates (PDCs), and multifunctional peptide complexes (MPCs). In radiopharmaceuticals, the company integrates peptide-based targeting with radioisotope labeling for both diagnostics and therapeutics.
categories.primary_customers_markets: PeptiDream's primary customers include major global pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology firms, and research institutions engaged in drug discovery partnerships and licensing. In the radiopharmaceutical segment, key customers are hospitals, clinics, and medical institutions utilizing diagnostic and therapeutic radiopharmaceuticals, with a significant portion of sales to organizations such as the Japan Isotope Association.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Japan, with significant business activities and partnerships in the United States and Europe. While radiopharmaceutical sales are concentrated in the Japanese market, the drug discovery segment is global, with collaborations and licensing agreements with leading pharmaceutical companies worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: PeptiDream is positioned both upstream and midstream in the pharmaceutical supply chain. In drug discovery, it acts as a platform provider and early-stage developer, supplying candidates and technologies to pharma partners. In radiopharmaceuticals, it is vertically integrated in Japan, covering R&D, manufacturing, and direct sales of finished products to healthcare providers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, PeptiDream focuses on expanding its proprietary PDPS platform, growing its pipeline of peptide-based therapeutics (including oral, injectable, and multifunctional formats), and advancing radiopharmaceuticals for oncology and CNS indications. The company emphasizes innovation in peptide-drug conjugates, multi-functional peptides, and targeted radiotherapeutics, while pursuing global partnerships and in-licensing to broaden its portfolio. Sustainability, diversity, and talent development are also key organizational priorities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through a mix of product sales (radiopharmaceuticals), upfront and milestone payments, research funding, technology licensing fees, and royalties from partnered drug discovery programs. The business model is hybrid, combining recurring product sales with milestone-driven and royalty-based income from collaborations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: PeptiDream is a global leader in peptide drug discovery, competing with other platform biotech firms and CDMOs specializing in peptides and radiopharmaceuticals. Its unique PDPS technology and extensive pharma partnerships position it as a preferred partner for peptide-based modalities. In Japan, it holds a leading position in radiopharmaceuticals, with few domestic rivals offering comparable integrated capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In FY2024, PeptiDream reported consolidated revenue of approximately 46.7 billion yen, with a significant year-on-year increase (162.6% of the previous year). Core operating profit reached 21.2 billion yen, and net income attributable to shareholders was 15.0 billion yen. The company has demonstrated strong growth, driven by major licensing deals and robust product sales, and maintains a solid financial base with over 48 billion yen in cash and equivalents.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: PeptiDream's value proposition lies in its ability to generate highly diverse, non-natural cyclic peptides with superior binding properties, enabling the creation of next-generation therapeutics and diagnostics that address unmet medical needs. Its PDPS platform offers partners rapid, efficient access to novel modalities, while its integrated radiopharmaceutical business provides unique, high-value products for precision medicine. The company differentiates itself through technological innovation, a broad and deep pipeline, and a proven track record of successful global partnerships.
